candidateEvidenceReuse.method: Frame number, native box, PNG SHA-256 and entire PNG file bytes must be identical to the genuinely viewed earlier evidence.
candidateEvidenceReuse.semanticApproval: Evidence identity only; actual judgments recorded separately.

wholeFrameCoverage.method: Prior genuine full1890 review is reused only for1855 exact native BGR array matches. New pages58-80 actually viewed, including every changed or additional frame. All2550 frames have actual or bit-identical previously viewed whole-scene coverage.
wholeFrameCoverage.limits: Ordered whole-scene representations and native detail crops are not every UHD pixel individually inspected or human continuous playback.

assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.candidateInterpretations: Previously viewed unchanged objects plus the existing S16 pouch/defocused forest and S18 dried flower heads. No real human face or added person observed.
assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.criticalScope: Six encoded native crops per16 regions: S03,S06-S09,S11-S17,S19 and S20 face/body/badge; all96 actually viewed through6 JPEG pages.
assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.observations: S17 transparent acrylic and open-eye artwork remain inert; S18 is empty grass and dried flowers; S19 has the original right window hand and partial lap hand, no third arm, with offscreen pouch edge retained. S20 holds its continuous10-second lake retreat; restored plush body/pendant, face and whole badge rim stay stable across both temporal joins. No new unrelated traveler, human head, or obvious background reset observed. S16 remaining visible leg movement remains continuous, without certifying mostly offscreen foot contact.
assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.titleScope: Opening title lies in the proven pixel-identical earlier reviewed range. This85-second prefix does not include final dedication or S48.
